name: LanceDB
description: Persist embedding vectors to a LanceDB table stored in a selected local folder.

inputs.name: vectors
inputs.description: One or more embedded vector collections to store.

controllers.name: embedding
controllers.description: Controller payload from TEXT_EMBEDDING to store generated vectors directly.

controllers.name: store
controllers.description: Controller handle for downstream retrieval nodes.

parameters.name: storage_path
parameters.description: Folder used to store the LanceDB database files.

parameters.name: table_name
parameters.description: Table name inside the selected LanceDB database.

parameters.name: write_mode
parameters.description: Whether to overwrite the table or append to it.

parameters.name: distance_metric
parameters.description: Distance metric used by the vector index.

parameters.name: create_vector_index
parameters.description: Create a vector index after writing the points.

parameters.name: num_partitions
parameters.description: Requested IVF partition count when creating the vector index.
